name: Banyan Tree Doha
positioning: Urban hotel in Doha's Mushaireb district, between West Bay and the Old City, officially named Banyan Tree Doha at La Cigale Mushaireb, with a design that combines Asian principles and Arabian heritage
best_for: Travelers who want a central Doha base close to Souq Waqif and the city's museums
Spa lovers looking for a vitality pool, herbal sauna, brine steam room and rain walk
Families who want a Kids Club and direct access to the Quest indoor theme park

facts.text: The hotel is located between West Bay and the Old City, close to Souq Waqif, the Corniche, the National Museum of Qatar, the Museum of Islamic Art and the Msheireb Museums.
The hotel offers easy access to the Doha Metro.
Rooms and suites blend contemporary luxury design with Arabic influences.
Rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling glass windows with views of Doha.
Rooms and suites offer views of the Arabian Gulf, gardens and Doha's historic old city.
Bathrooms each have a separate bathtub and walk-in shower.
Harmony Sky Suite guests receive club benefits.
The Bliss Signature Suite has panoramic views of the bay or the oasis.
The spa combines its signature treatments with hydrothermal facilities in The Rainforest.
The hotel has an outdoor pool and an indoor pool with a jet spa.
The hotel has a fully equipped fitness centre and a Kids Club.
The hotel's restaurants serve modern Thai, Italian and Indian cuisine.

highlights.text: The spa has separate male and female areas with treatment rooms, heated beds, a vitality pool with a Jacuzzi, relaxation areas, a brine steam room, a herbal sauna and a rain walk.
The Harmony Sky Suite has panoramic views of Doha, a separate dining room, a living area, a bedroom with a walk-in closet and a bathroom with views.
Set within Doha Oasis, the hotel has direct access to the indoor theme park Quest and the Printemps Doha department store.
The property's design combines traditional Asian principles with Arabian heritage.
Vertigo is a club on level 28 with 360-degree views of Doha.

considerations.text: The hotel is in the city rather than on the sea; guests have free access to West Bay Beach, a 10-minute drive from the hotel.
Rooms and suites do not have balconies, while all the residences do.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
